name: build123d
readme_summary: Build123d is a Python framework for parametric 2D and 3D CAD modeling, built on the Open Cascade geometric kernel. It offers a Pythonic interface for creating precise models suitable for manufacturing processes like 3D printing and CNC machining.
key_features: Built on Open Cascade geometric kernel
Suitable for 3D printing, CNC machining, laser cutting
Export formats to popular CAD tools
primary_use_case: Creating precise, parametric 2D and 3D CAD models programmatically using Python for manufacturing applications.
cover_image_prompt: A master craftsman, akin to a digital sculptor, stands in a workshop filled with glowing blueprints. They are using a magical Pythonic quill to draw intricate 3D models directly into existence from thin air. One hand holds a glowing Python script, while the other guides the quill, transforming lines of code into tangible, complex geometric shapes like gears and brackets that float around them. Subtle digital particles and data streams flow from the script to the quill. The workshop has a clean, modern aesthetic with hints of a CAD interface on a nearby screen. The overall mood is one of creation and precision. The image should be in a 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing the transformation of code into physical objects.

name: m3e-canvas
description: Sketch Material 3 Expressive screens in the browser and turn them into vibe-coding prompts.
readme_summary: M3E Canvas is a browser-based design tool that allows users to visually sketch and prototype Material 3 Expressive UI screens. It enables linking screens, simulating tap-through navigation, and generating AI-friendly prompts for code generation.
key_features: Support for phone and desktop screen sizes with responsive layout adjustments
Generates prompts for AI coding tools
primary_use_case: Rapid prototyping and design of Material 3 Expressive mobile and desktop UIs, with the ability to generate prompts for AI-powered code generation.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical digital artist, akin to a conductor, standing before a grand orchestra of glowing UI elements. The artist gestures with a stylus, transforming simple shapes and lines into a fully realized, interactive Material 3 Expressive app interface that floats in the air. On one side, raw design components like buttons and cards are visible, while on the other, a stream of code flows from the interface into a futuristic AI brain icon. The scene is set in a bright, modern studio with subtle digital particles and the 'M3E Canvas' name subtly integrated into a floating blueprint. The style should be a vibrant 3D isometric illustration with a clean, inviting color palette.

name: OpenBot
description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
readme_summary: OpenBot is an open-source platform for running AI agents, referred to as 'coworkers,' within your own infrastructure. It provides each agent with a dedicated browser, file access, and tools, all governed by a secure gateway that logs every action. This allows for trusted delegation of real work to AI agents.
key_features: AI agents with dedicated browsers, files, and tools
Action decision and recording via a central gateway
Runs on your own infrastructure (Docker Compose)
Supports any AG-UI compliant agent framework
Configurable agents (e.g., General Assistant, Knowledge, Risk Analyst)
primary_use_case: To provide a secure and auditable platform for deploying and managing AI agents that can perform real-world tasks within a user's own computing environment.
cover_image_prompt: A bustling, futuristic workshop where anthropomorphic robots, each with a unique digital interface screen displaying browser windows and file icons, are diligently working on various tasks. One robot is carefully handing a complex blueprint to another, who is then meticulously analyzing it on its screen. Subtle glowing data streams flow between the robots and a central, secure-looking console that logs their actions. The overall mood is one of focused productivity and trust, with the repository name 'OpenBot' subtly integrated into the workshop's signage. The style should be a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a bright, optimistic color palette.

name: DevToys
description: A Swiss Army knife for developers.
readme_summary: DevToys is a comprehensive suite of developer tools designed to streamline daily tasks. It offers a wide array of utilities for converting, encoding/decoding, formatting, generating, and testing various data types, all within a user-friendly interface. The application also features smart detection to automatically select the appropriate tool for clipboard content and supports extensibility for custom tools.
key_features: Bundle of tiny tools for specific tasks
Smart Detection for automatic tool selection
Encoders/Decoders (HTML, URL, Base64, GZip, JWT, QR Code)
Graphics Tools (Color Blindness Simulator, Image Compressor)
primary_use_case: To provide developers with a single, efficient application containing a wide variety of essential utilities for common development tasks, reducing the need for multiple external tools or websites.
cover_image_prompt: A highly organized, futuristic workbench for a digital artisan. In the center, a glowing, multifaceted Swiss Army knife is open, revealing various specialized tools like a magnifying glass examining code snippets, a precision screwdriver tightening data structures, and a digital brush smoothing out complex text. Around the knife, different data inputs like glowing JSON blocks, tangled URL strings, and raw text documents are being neatly transformed into clean, organized outputs like perfectly formatted code, clear charts, and secure encrypted messages. Subtle UI elements and digital particles flow between the tools and the outputs, indicating seamless processing. The overall mood is one of efficiency and clarity, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant, contrasting colors and sharp, clear details.
